$comment: Evidence pack for the sGHO (Aave Savings GHO) balance-adapter verification. The fork test hardcodes the values below (real holder, pinned block) and asserts the adapter reports the exact convertToAssets GHO value. The GHO value is the vm.rollFork value — exact at the block's timestamp; a live dev anvil reads marginally higher as it advances block.timestamp while mining.

groundTruth.noOverReporting: synthetic suite redeems 100% of shares and asserts GHO received ~= oracle-reported amount (no exit fee / cooldown)
groundTruth.exactValue: oracle.getOracleBalanceForAsset == sGHO.convertToAssets(holder shares) at the pinned block
groundTruth.identity: protocolId == erc4626; positionId == abi.encode(wrapper); positionKind == Supplied

aaveUiReconciliation: Aave 'Savings GHO (sGHO)' tile shows the sGHO share count (~4.58M); the withdraw preview shows redeemable GHO (~4.59M). The adapter reports the latter (convertToAssets), matching 'you'll receive 4.59M GHO'. The ~0.29% gap is accrued savings yield.
